models: Fender Stratocaster (B.C. Rich, Gibson Explorer used early)

guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with medium confidence given documented but varied gear.

tone.target: bright jangly indie-pop crunch with slight chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright jangly indie-pop crunch with slight chorus sheen
tone.summary: A classic indie-pop chain utilizing a mild boost for attack, Chorus for sheen, and the US Deluxe amp model paired with a 2x12 cab to achieve a bright, jangly, chimey sound.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Enhance the tight rhythmic attack and sustain for jangly chords.
Add the required light chorus sheen without sounding overly wet.
Provide the necessary clean breakup and slight grit for indie-pop crunch.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender/Vox-style amp tone.
Match the required bright, compact cabinet sound (2x12).
Boost the bright upper mids and high end for maximum jangle.
Add subtle space and dimension without sounding muddy.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better high-end clarity and chime.

proposals.reason: Enhance bright upper mids and jangle quality.
